programme.title: The Yearling (1994)
programme.desc: A sensitive teenager grows up with a pet fawn in the Florida wilderness in the 1930s.

programme.title: Love's Everlasting Courage (2011)
programme.desc: Farmer Clark Davis struggles to repay a loan and save his land during a drought. Making matters worse, his wife becomes gravely ill after agreeing to take a job in order to bring in more income.

programme.title: The Nanny Express (2009)
programme.desc: A spunky nanny (Vanessa Marcil) tries to win over her rebellious charges, who are coping with the death of their mother. Romance soon blooms between the nanny and the kids' father (Brennan Elliott), but the relationship could stall if the kids object. Dean Stockwell and Stacy Keach also star.

programme.title: My George (2014)
programme.desc: A struggling writer pens a romance novel, and then she searches for an ideal boyfriend like the one in her book to help her agent with publicity. Before long, she meets a charming real-estate agent and reconnects with an old high-school friend.

programme.title: Mr. Write (2016)
programme.desc: When editor Dori meets her idol, romantic novelist Michael, she's crushed to learn he doesn't really believe in true love. But when Dori's own romance falls apart, only Michael can pick up the pieces and renew her belief in love and in him.

programme.title: What I Did for Love (2006)
programme.desc: After a lawyer (Jeremy London) proposes to his girlfriend (Dorie Barton), they head to her family's ranch for the holidays, where he must gain approval from her difficult dad (James Gammon) and cope with her scheming aunt (Sally Struthers), who informs her niece's ex-flame of the blossoming relationship. Mark Griffiths directed.

programme.title: Always and Forever (2009)
programme.desc: Former high-school sweethearts Grace and Michael (Rena Sofer and Dean McDermott) reconnect at their 20-year high-school reunion. Sparks fly, but the pair are hesitant to jump into a relationship that already failed once. Grace's mom (Barbara Eden), meanwhile, is quick to offer her two cents on her daughter's romantic woes. Max Gail and Rob Boltin also star. Directed by Kevin Connor.

programme.title: Diagnosis Delicious (2016)
programme.desc: A disgraced chef and an ambitious cardiologist who can't even boil water cross paths when she takes his cooking class. Now she must convince the hot-headed chef to teach her hospital's new Healthy Living seminars, but he has another idea.

programme.title: The Last Cowboy (2003)
programme.desc: A woman returns home to Texas after an eight-year absence to claim the ranch her grandfather left to her in his will. Unfortunately, she has to somehow bridge the generation gap when she finds herself at loggerheads with her father.

programme.title: Hometown Hero (2016)
programme.desc: Romance develops when a cynical divorce mediator has to take care of a client's dog.

programme.title: A Time to Remember (2003)
programme.desc: An artist and single mother (Dana Delany) returns to her childhood home town for Thanksgiving to reconcile with her mother (Doris Roberts), who suffers from Alzheimer's.

programme.title: It Had to Be You (2015)
programme.desc: An ad exec whose boutique agency was swallowed up by her powerful father's firm, begrudgingly becomes attracted to the office rival she's force to work with on an important account.

programme.desc: Amiable family farce centers around the put-upon parents (John Larroquette, Karen Valentine) of three brides planning simultaneous nuptials. French Stewart, Marina Black. programme.title: Wild Hearts (2006)
programme.desc: When Bob Hart, a widowed police detective trying to raise a rebellious teenage daughter, inherits a Montana horse ranch, he jumps at the opportunity to leave Los Angeles for the open range. Soon after arriving, Bob accepts the position as county sheriff and discovers that the seemingly bucolic countryside is far from tranquil. His problems include wolves who attack his stock, ruthless developers trying to take over the town and a female veterinarian with a chip on her shoulder.

programme.title: After the Fall (2010)
programme.desc: A talented equestrian (Andrea Bowen) is paralyzed after an accident and must go through physical therapy in hopes of someday walking again. Directed by Bradford May.

He relishes his new ability until he realizes that it's taking a toll on his own health, forcing him to make an important decision. Lisa Sheridan, Patrick Duffy, Meagen Fay. Directed by Bradford May.

programme.title: A Son's Promise (1990)
programme.desc: Rick Schroder as the eldest of seven brothers, battling to keep his siblings together. Filmed in Georgia. Dorothy: Veronica Cartwright. Weston: Boyd Gaines. Paw Paw: Donald Moffat. Wayne: David Andrews. Tommy: Andrew Lowery. Charles: Stephen Dorff. Renolds: Ken Strong. Judge: Danny Nelson. David: Ryan Marshall.

programme.title: Oliver's Ghost (2011)
programme.desc: A young boy (Nicholas Stargel) befriends a ghost (Martin Mull) living in the attic of his family's new house in a small town. After several angry outbursts from the ghost, the boy tries to get to the bottom of what's plaguing him. Directed by Dave S. Cass Sr.

programme.title: Foxfire (1987)
programme.desc: Jessica Tandy and Hume Cronyn re-create their Broadway roles as homesteaders in this study of change and tradition in Appalachia. Tandy won an Emmy (after earning a Tony on stage). Dillard: John Denver. Prince: Gary Grubbs. Holly: Harriet Hall. Filmed in Highlands, N.C., and Rabun County, Ga. Directed by Jud Taylor. Adapted by Susan Cooper, who co-wrote the original play with Cronyn.

programme.title: Reading, Writing & Romance (2013)
programme.desc: A struggling actor takes a job teaching high-school English and begins a romance with another teacher. But when he lands a big acting gig, he must decide if he's willing to leave behind his new life.

programme.title: Mr. Fiction (2014)
programme.desc: Emma, a young bookshop owner and hopeless romantic, has to make some tough life choices when the man of her dreams walks into her store.

programme.title: Brimming With Love (2017)
programme.desc: A skeptical journalist writing a column on a matchmaking coffee shop owner agrees to be matched, but she proves to be a challenge. The reason may be that she is perfect for the matchmaker.

programme.title: Mixed Baggage (2022)
programme.desc: When Evie Jones rushes off a flight to make her connection, she has no idea that in her haste, she has grabbed the wrong duffel bag.

programme.title: A Kiss at Midnight (2008)
programme.desc: A woman (Faith Ford) who runs a dating service registers with a rival Internet matchmaker to prove her business is better, but ends up being successfully matched with the site's owner (Cameron Daddo). Dyan Cannon and Hal Linden also star.

programme.title: Playing Father (2013)
programme.desc: A jazz musician takes a teaching gig at a struggling school and mentors a talented but troubled student. As he helps the teen confront problems at home and school, he also begins to focus on healing his relationship with his own distant son.

programme.title: Where There's a Will (2006)
programme.desc: A debt-ridden con man returns home to care for his wealthy grandmother hoping to become her sole heir.

programme.title: Advance And Retreat (2016)
programme.desc: An ambitious junior executive is reunited with her first love at a corporate retreat and ultimately realizes that she might have to take a step back to make a leap forward.

programme.title: The Flower Girl (2009)
programme.desc: A young florist and wedding planner suddenly goes from being single and unlucky at love, to dating two fantastic men, and is forced to make a life-altering decision about her fundamental values about love and family.

programme.title: The Cabin (2011)
programme.desc: A divorced mom (Lea Thompson) and her kids are forced to bunk with a single dad (Steven Brand) and his two children after a cabin mix-up at a resort in Scotland. Though the adults initially clash, they decide to join forces to compete in a sporting event at the resort, and it's not long before sparks start to fly. Directed by Brian Trenchard-Smith.

programme.title: Bound & Babysitting (2015)
programme.desc: A couple need a babysitter so they can go on a much-needed romantic getaway, so they enlist the help of two friends who have been enemies since college in hopes that they realize how much they have in common.

programme.title: Happily Never After (2017)
programme.desc: Kate is part of a writing duo with her boyfriend, and thinks her author days are over when they split, until her publisher requests a sequel.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: The story of the Mitchell brothers is related. Renowned pornographers, Artie and Jim engaged in a fierce sibling rivalry that ended when Artie was shot three times, including a fatal wound to his head. Investigators relied upon a 911 call, during which shots could be heard, and computer animation to reconstruct what happened. Jim was later convicted of voluntary manslaughter and sentenced to six years.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: The murder of a female prison guard leads police to suspect inmates at the facility, but the discovery of a "signature" element enables them to focus their investigation on two prisoners.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: The disappearance of a 9-year-old girl leads police to suspect her father, Brad Jackson, of murdering her. They plant global positioning devices on his vehicles and track him via satellite. Unknowingly, he leads them to the site where he buried her body.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: The brutal assault of a Maine state trooper is connected to an 8-month-old murder case in New Jersey by the "signature" the alleged killer, Steven Fortin, used in both crimes.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: The disappearance of 19-year-old Lori Auker leaves police stumped due to the poor quality of a surveillance tape. With help from NASA, however, digital imaging was employed to clean up the video; later, three hairs that belonged to her cat were found in a suspect's trunk, leading to his arrest and eventual conviction.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: The apparent suicide of a Michigan woman, who died from a gunshot wound to the head, is investigated.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A woman searches for the individual who injured her daughter in an accident.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: The case of Caleb Fairley is detailed. After a woman and her daughter disappeared, forensic evidence pointed to the 23-year-old. He eventually was convicted of a double homicide and sentenced to life in prison.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: The death of Walter Scott, better known as Walter Notheis Jr, lead singer for the 1960s band Bob Kuban and the In-Men, is detailed. He disappeared In 1983. The husband of a woman Scott was involved with was later arrested and convicted of murdering both Scott and his unfaithful wife.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: An examination of an unusual case in Texas involving the 1988 rape and murder of a pizza-parlour employee. After a suspect confessed, and he and an alleged accomplice were imprisoned, the case was considered closed. Eight years later, however, another man confessed to the same crime---and DNA evidence cleared the first suspect while implicating that the second was, in fact, guilty.

programme.title: Forensic Files II
programme.desc: A massive explosion claims the life of a California farmhand. Authorities think it's an accidental death, but analysis of debris shows it's a bomb. Investigators have few suspects until they hear ominous rumors about a jealous rage.

programme.title: Forensic Files II
programme.desc: When a beautiful college student is stabbed to death in her Knoxville apartment, suspicion immediately falls on her roommate. A bloody shoeprint left by the killer exposes a murderer with no history of violence and no reason to kill.

programme.title: Forensic Files II
programme.desc: Someone targets members of law enforcement in a peaceful Texas county. Numerous suspects emerge, and murders continue as detectives race against time. Finally, a single bullet casing uncovers the bizarre reason for which the killer wanted revenge.

programme.title: Forensic Files II
programme.desc: An Illinois mother and her two young children are brutally murdered in their beds. Lurid threats are spray-painted all over the walls of the crime scene. Detectives discover death threats sent to the family, exposing an unlikely killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files II
programme.desc: A young Texas teenager and her boyfriend are brutally attacked on Valentine's Day; she is found dead while her boyfriend escapes. The case goes cold for nearly 50 years before a new forensic test exposes a family man with a dark secret.

programme.title: Forensic Files II
programme.desc: Three Indiana construction workers are found shot on a work site. Detectives find few suspects, but have one clue: one of the killers stepped in dog feces during the murders, If detectives can find his shoes, they've got their man.

programme.title: Forensic Files II
programme.desc: A Texas ex-con resolves to live a clean life after his release from prison. When he's later arrested and convicted for a bloody murder, he insists he's innocent. From behind bars, he's determined to use forensic science to prove his case.

programme.title: Forensic Files II
programme.desc: An extremely successful California career woman keeps falling ill and doctors can't determine why. When she dies, they still have no explanation, until they find a key figure in her life has been lying about his past.

programme.title: Forensic Files II
programme.desc: The body of a 24-year-old criminology student was found wrapped in a blanket alongside a desolate road in Brooklyn, New York. Police discover the bouncer at a SoHo bar was her killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files II
programme.desc: A 79-year-old woman is found shot to death in her home. Investigators initially suspect her husband or a violent neighbor. Shell casings recovered at the scene and a high-tech database reveal the unlikely killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A look back at a trio of unsolved murders that occurred in Wichita Falls, Texas, during the 1980s details how a fourth murder from the same time period provided the police with more than they realised. John Little, an investigator for the DA's office, picked up the cold cases years later. He soon connected the fourth crime's confessed killer, Faryion Wardrip, to the other murders.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A chronicle of how a single hair helped the police identify where a murder victim pulled from the river had been, and how it helped lead to the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: An examination of the Crystal Faye Todd case. In 1991, the 17-year-old was brutally murdered in Horry County, South Carolina. The police asked 52 male acquaintances to provide blood samples so that they could compare the DNA to semen found at the murder scene. The process eliminated all but one young man---and he's now serving a life sentence.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: An examination of the first time animal DNA was used to solve a criminal case. In 1994 Canada, on Prince Edward Island, the body of Douglas Beamish's estranged wife was discovered. Authorities linked 20 cat hairs found on her jacket to a cat owned by Beamish's parents, with whom he lived. Scientists estimated that chances that the hairs came from another feline were one in 50 million. A jury later convicted Beamish of second-degree murder; he was sentenced to 18 years without parole.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: An outbreak of food poisoning in 1984 Oregon leads authorities to a religious cult.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A woman's death is investigated. The husband claims it was suicide; but the police suspect otherwise.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: The Madalyn Murray O'Hair case is related. The founder of American Atheists disappeared in 1995 along with her son and granddaughter and $500,000 in gold coins. In time, the police honed in on several suspects, including David Roland Waters, who worked as the office manager for O'Hair's organisation. In 2001, he led authorities to her grave, located on a ranch near San Antonio, Texas.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Witnesses claim to have seen a white van run over a man in an alley behind a bar, but when the police respond they find no body and no blood on the van.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: Investigators rely on insects and a forensic entomologist to determine when a murder victim was killed.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: The investigation into the abduction of an 18-year-old girl is aided when the victim returns hours after the incident occurred. With her help, the police are able to track the assailant to his front door.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: The police investigate when a severed leg is discovered in the garbage. Conventional means of identifying the victim are impossible, leading investigators to rely on DNA, anthropology and toxicology to identify the victim and, hopefully, catch the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: How Illinois scientists solved a 1992 murder case involving cremation.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: A look back at the case of the "River Park Rapist", who assaulted four women in South Bend, Indiana during 1996. Law enforcement officers arrested a suspect, who was convicted in 1998 and sentenced to 70 years in prison. In 2000, however, new evidence suggested that he was innocent.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: The murder of a suburban couple is detailed. Investigators first believe the slayings were the result of a drug deal gone bad. However, no drugs are found in the house and the victims' blood isn't present on the clothing of the suspects. The couple's dog eventually leads authorities to the murderer.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.desc: The investigation into a suspicious death hits a dead end when the autopsy indicates that no foul play was involved. But a telephone tip and the sensitive nose of a forensic examiner indicate otherwise.

programme.title: Forensic Files

programme.title: Stanley Cup Playoff
programme.sub-title: Game 5: Florida Panthers vs. Tampa Bay Lightning
programme.desc: Florida Panthers vs. Tampa Bay Lightning in Game 5 of an Eastern Conference first-round series. From Amalie Arena. A stunning blitz of goals in the last minutes of Game 4 gave the reigning-champion Panthers a 3-1 series lead as Tampa Bay stares at first-round elimination for a third straight year. Florida has scored the first goal in all four contests, with Anton Lundell doing so in Game 4.

programme.title: Stanley Cup Playoff
programme.sub-title: Game 7: Florida Panthers at Toronto Maple Leafs
programme.desc: Florida Panthers at Toronto Maple Leafs in Game 7 of an Eastern Conference second-round series. From Scotiabank Arena. Craig Berube's Leafs come home looking to snap their six-game losing streak in Game 7s, having last won one in 2004 vs. Ottawa. Third-period goals by captain Auston Matthews and veteran winger Max Pacioretty beat Florida 2-0 in Game 6, forcing the fifth Game 7 for the Panthers, who improved to 3-1 in deciding games when beating Edmonton to win last season's Stanley Cup.

programme.title: Stanley Cup Playoff
programme.sub-title: Game 5: Florida Panthers at Carolina Hurricanes
programme.desc: Florida Panthers at Carolina Hurricanes in Game 5 of the Eastern Conference Final. From Lenovo Center. Star defenseman Jaccob Slavin and the 'Canes willed the series back to Raleigh with a 3-0 must-win in Game 4, staving off Florida's first bid for a third straight trip to the Cup Final. Fredrik Andersen stopped all 20 Panthers shots as Carolina got its first win a conference final since 2006.

programme.title: Stanley Cup Final
programme.sub-title: Game 1: Florida Panthers at Edmonton Oilers
programme.desc: Florida Panthers at Edmonton Oilers in Game 1 of the NHL's best-of-seven championship series. From Rogers Place. The first rematch in the Cup Final since 2009 (Red Wings-Penguins) pits Paul Maurice's defending-champion Panthers against Edmonton and perennial MVP candidates Leon Draisaitl and Connor McDavid. The Oilers famously rallied from a 3-0 series hole before falling 2-1 in Game 7 last June.

programme.title: Stanley Cup Final
programme.sub-title: Game 2: Florida Panthers at Edmonton Oilers
programme.desc: Florida Panthers at Edmonton Oilers in Game 2 of the NHL's best-of-seven championship series. From Rogers Place. The Oilers rallied from a 3-1 hole to take Game 1 in overtime as Leon Draisaitl scored the game's first and last goals. Edmonton peppered Panthers goalie Sergei Bobrovsky with 46 shots and snapped Florida's five-game road win streak this postseason. Sam Bennett scored twice in defeat.

programme.title: Stanley Cup Final
programme.sub-title: Game 3: Edmonton Oilers at Florida Panthers
programme.desc: Edmonton Oilers at Florida Panthers in Game 3 of the NHL championship series. From Amerant Bank Arena. The defending champs skate home tied 1-1 with Edmonton after splitting two overtime games. Veteran Brad Marchand ended Game 2 with an 89th minute goal to go with an earlier shorthanded go-ahead goal. Sergei Bobrovsky made 42 saves in the win for Florida, which is just 4-3 at home this postseason.

programme.title: Stanley Cup Final
programme.sub-title: Game 4: Edmonton Oilers at Florida Panthers
programme.desc: Edmonton Oilers at Florida Panthers in Game 4 of the NHL championship series. From Amerant Bank Arena. Paul Maurice's Panthers are halfway to repeating as Cup champions after dominating Edmonton 6-1 in Game 3, with Sam Bennett and Brad Marchand both scoring their fourth goals of the series. Sergei Bobrovsky stopped 32 shots by the Oilers, who fell to 1-4 in the Sunshine State in Cup Final games. Edmonton star Leon Draisaitl was held without a shot on goal, while teammate Evan Bouchard had nine.

programme.title: Stanley Cup Final
programme.sub-title: Game 5: Florida Panthers at Edmonton Oilers
programme.desc: Florida Panthers at Edmonton Oilers in Game 5 of the NHL championship series. From Rogers Place. This scintillating best-of-seven skates back to Canada tied 2-2 after Oilers goalie Calvin Pickard (7-0 this postseason) stopped 22 of 23 Florida shots in relief in Game 4, allowing Leon Draisaitl to deposit his NHL-record fourth overtime goal of the postseason for a 5-4 victory.

programme.title: Stanley Cup Final
programme.sub-title: Game 6: Edmonton Oilers at Florida Panthers
programme.desc: Edmonton Oilers at Florida Panthers in Game 6 of the NHL championship series. From Amerant Bank Arena. Up 3-2, the Panthers are one win away from repeating as Cup champions and bringing the Sunshine State its fourth NHL title in six years. Florida foiled the Oilers 5-2 in Game 5 behind hot scorers Brad Marchand and Sam Bennett, and have an 8-0 edge in first-period scoring the last three games.

programme.desc: Indiana Pacers at Cleveland Cavaliers in Game 2 of an Eastern Conference semifinal series. From Rocket Arena. Donovan Mitchell's record-setting eighth straight Game 1 with 30-plus points went for naught for Cleveland, which allowed the Pacers to shoot 19-for-36 on threes.

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.sub-title: Game 5: New York Knicks at Boston Celtics
programme.desc: New York Knicks at Boston Celtics in Game 5 of an Eastern Conference semifinal series. From TD Garden. The Knicks are one win away from their first conference final in a quarter century after fending off Boston 121-113 in Game 4 behind Jalen Brunson's 39 points and 12 assists. Celtics star Jayson Tatum left with a leg injury in the final minutes after pouring in 42 points.

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.sub-title: Game 6: Boston Celtics at New York Knicks
programme.desc: Boston Celtics at New York Knicks in Game 6 of an Eastern Conference semifinal series. From Madison Square Garden. Down 3-2, reigning-champion Boston won't go quietly despite losing star forward Jayson Tatum to injury. Jaylen Brown, Derrick White (60 points combined) and reserve center Luke Kornet starred in a 127-102 Game 5 win, delaying New York's bid for its first Eastern final in 25 years.

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.sub-title: Game 2: New York Knicks at Boston Celtics
programme.desc: New York Knicks at Boston Celtics in Game 2 of an Eastern Conference semifinal series. From TD Garden. Tom Thibodeau's Knicks try to maintain the momentum of a gritty 108-105 overtime win in the opener in which they trailed Boston by 20 in the second half. OG Anunoby and Jalen Brunson scored a game-high 29 in the win, which snapped a nine-game home playoff win streak for the Celtics dating back to Game 2 of last spring's second round vs. Cleveland.

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.sub-title: Game 2: Denver Nuggets at Oklahoma City Thunder
programme.desc: Denver Nuggets at Oklahoma City Thunder in Game 2 of a Western Conference semifinal series. From Paycom Center. Top-seeded OKC tries to bounce back from a demoralizing 121-119 loss to the Nuggets in Game 1, which the Thunder led for the entire second half until Aaron Gordon's three in the final seconds. Nikola Jokic amassed team-highs of 42 points, 22 boards, six assists and seven turnovers.

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.sub-title: Game 3: Boston Celtics at Orlando Magic
programme.desc: Boston Celtics at Orlando Magic in Game 3 of an Eastern Conference first-round series. NBA-champion Boston is up 2-0 as action shifts south to the Magic City, where the C's have lost on their last four regular-season visits. Jaylen Brown's 36 points, 10 boards and five assists keyed a 109-100 win in Game 2 with sidekick Jayson Tatum sidelined (wrist). Orlando's Paolo Banchero scored 32 in defeat.

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.sub-title: Game 4: Boston Celtics at Orlando Magic
programme.desc: Boston Celtics at Orlando Magic in Game 4 of an Eastern Conference first-round series. From Kia Center. Boston's losing streak on the Magic's homecourt is at five after a 95-93 loss in Game 3 that cut the Celtics' series lead to 2-1. Jayson Tatum and Jaylen Brown combined for 55 points but also 13 of Boston's 21 turnovers. Franz Wagner's 32 points and eight assists led Orlando.

programme.title: Heretic

programme.title: The Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers

programme.title: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King

programme.title: Dark Side of the 90s
programme.desc: The story of how the upstart Fox Network forever changed television.

programme.title: Ghostbusters: Frozen Empire
programme.desc: The Spengler family returns to the iconic New York City firehouse with the original Ghostbusters. When an ancient artifact unleashes an evil force, Ghostbusters new and old must unite to protect their home and save the world from a second ice age.

programme.title: The Lord of the Rings: The War of the Rohirrim
programme.desc: A sudden attack by Wulf, a ruthless Dunlending lord, forces Helm Hammerhand and his people to make a daring last stand in the ancient stronghold of the Hornburg. Finding herself in a desperate situation, Helm's daughter must lead the resistance.

programme.title: The SpongeBob SquarePants Movie
programme.desc: SpongeBob (Tom Kenny) and Patrick (Bill Fagerbakke) head for Shell City to retrieve King Neptune's stolen crown and save the life of Mr. Krabs (Clancy Brown).

programme.title: A Minecraft Movie
programme.desc: A mysterious portal pulls four misfits into the Overworld, a bizarre, cubic wonderland that thrives on imagination. To get back home, they'll have to master the terrain while embarking on a magical quest with an unexpected crafter named Steve.

programme.title: Top Gun
programme.desc: For Lieutenant Pete "Maverick" Mitchell and his friend and co-pilot Nick "Goose" Bradshaw, being accepted into an elite training school for fighter pilots is a dream come true. But a tragedy will threaten Pete's dreams of becoming an ace pilot.

programme.title: Jurassic World Dominion
programme.desc: Four years after the destruction of Isla Nublar, Biosyn operatives attempt to track down Maisie Lockwood, while Dr Ellie Sattler investigates a genetically engineered swarm of giant insects.

programme.title: Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire
programme.desc: Godzilla and the almighty Kong face a colossal threat hidden deep within the planet, challenging their very existence and the survival of the human race.

programme.title: Waves
programme.desc: The epic emotional journey of a suburban African American family as they navigate love, forgiveness and coming together in the wake of a tragic loss.

programme.title: Paseo
programme.desc: A woman becomes displaced and alienated by her surroundings while traveling through Spain. She begins to lose control of her emotional and psychological self as she explores another possible life.

programme.title: Polar Storm
programme.desc: A scientist must save the day when violent storms threaten Earth's magnetic poles.

programme.title: The Addams Family 2
programme.desc: Hoping to get closer as a family, Gomez, Morticia and the rest of the Addams clan embark on an adventurous road trip in a hideous and humongous camper.

programme.title: Jurassic World
programme.desc: An ex-military man and animal expert must use his special skills to save tourists at the Jurassic World island resort from rampaging, genetically engineered dinosaurs, including the vicious and intelligent Indominus rex.

programme.title: Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom
programme.desc: Owen and Claire return to the island of Isla Nublar to save the remaining dinosaurs from a volcano that's about to erupt. They soon encounter terrifying new breeds of gigantic dinos while uncovering a conspiracy that threatens the entire planet.

programme.title: Elf
programme.desc: Adopted as a baby by one of Santa's elves (Bob Newhart), a man (Will Ferrell) leaves the workshop to search for his family in New York.

programme.title: Jurassic Park
programme.desc: An entrepreneur invites scientists (Sam Neill, Laura Dern), a mathematics theorist (Jeff Goldblum) and others to his jungle theme-park featuring dinosaurs regenerated from DNA.

programme.title: Madame Web
programme.desc: Cassandra Webb is a New York City paramedic who starts to show signs of clairvoyance. Forced to confront revelations about her past, she must protect three young women from a mysterious adversary who wants them dead.

programme.title: The Day the Earth Blew Up: A Looney Tunes Movie
programme.desc: Porky Pig and Daffy Duck become Earth's only hope when their antics at the local bubble-gum factory uncover a secret alien mind-control plot. Faced with cosmic odds, they must save their town and the world while not driving each other totally looney.

programme.title: And Just Like That...
programme.desc: Carrie navigates long-distance with Aidan; Miranda considers ghosting a hookup; Charlotte tries to redeem Mr. Burton.

programme.title: And Just Like That...
programme.desc: Carrie attempts to decipher the meaning behind Aidan's text messages; Seema hesitantly accepts the idea of meeting with a matchmaker; Charlotte and LTW discreetly follow a college admissions consultant.

programme.title: Beau Is Afraid

programme.title: The Radleys
programme.desc: The Radleys are a seemingly average family with a juicy secret: they're vampires. However, they can only abstain from their natural cravings for so long until the bloody truth bubbles to the surface and turns their quiet country life upside down.
